0xBC6-0xBE0: state+0xC0 += vdup(*[sp,#0x68]) * q5. On this path q5 is those vdiv qNaNs and *yp is +Inf, so C0/C4/C8/CC all become 0x7FC00000.
0xBE2-0xC9E 439f88/439efc clamps write state[0xC8]=-1 and state[0xCC]=0 (second store is at state + (int)state[0xBC]*4 + 0xBC).
0xC56-0xD14: vst4 of (vld4(state+8) - (q5*s18)*load(sp+0x188)) back to state+8 smears qNaN 0x7FC00000 across state[0x08..0x44].
0xD18 cbz r7 skips 0xD38 because 43bfac was 0. State at 0xD4E is unchanged from 0xD18.
